taixuan_zhaoxi_hit.label: 照隙：锐点
taixuan_zhaoxi_hit.presentation: 玉白剑尖贯入，极窄青白剑痕与一个局部亮点迅速消散。

taixuan_qinghui_hit.label: 清辉反击：交锋
taixuan_qinghui_hit.presentation: 返照反击在真实命中处显出两道交错细锋，同一瞬间收成玉白亮点。

taixuan_jiuxiao_hit.label: 九霄：落星
taixuan_jiuxiao_hit.presentation: 每名实际被剑雨击中的目标只出现一个四芒落星，剑雨构形不复制伤害。

taixuan_liuguang_hit.label: 追星：单段星芒
taixuan_liuguang_hit.presentation: 每个实际攻击段各显一个短促四芒贯刺，单个效果不自行连闪四次。

taixuan_xinghe_hit.label: 星河：六芒
taixuan_xinghe_hit.presentation: 向外剑势在实际目标上收为六芒星，护身与反击各有清楚读点。

taixuan_taiqing_hit.label: 太清：域中细锋
taixuan_taiqing_hit.presentation: 领域每次真实剑击一个克制的十字亮峰，重点目标加剑沿用真实 helper。

taixuan_yixiantian_hit.label: 一线天：贯穿读点
taixuan_yixiantian_hit.presentation: 实际受伤目标留一道长而极窄的局部剑痕；本资产不承担三十米整条长锋。

taixuan_zhaoxi_cast.label: 照隙：凝锋
taixuan_zhaoxi_cast.presentation: 一柄青白气剑在身前短促凝锋，稳定剑尖后迅速收束。

taixuan_qinghui_cast.label: 清辉：护弧初展
taixuan_qinghui_cast.presentation: 三柄细剑围身展开半弧，返照护体随后维持疏朗循环。

taixuan_jiuxiao_cast.label: 九霄：剑冠
taixuan_jiuxiao_cast.presentation: 六柄细长气剑在身周上方排成剑冠，短促下压收束，目标各有落星读点。

taixuan_liuguang_cast.label: 追星：四锋
taixuan_liuguang_cast.presentation: 四柄窄锋构成起招轮廓；后续四个实际攻击段分别给出命中峰。

taixuan_xinghe_cast.label: 星河：外推剑环
taixuan_xinghe_cast.presentation: 八柄细剑由内向外推出一道低密度剑环，释放后快速退亮。

taixuan_taiqing_cast.label: 太清：开域
taixuan_taiqing_cast.presentation: 六柄细剑从近身向外轻展，接入六米随身剑域的稀疏边界。

taixuan_yixiantian_cast.label: 一线天：多锋归一
taixuan_yixiantian_cast.presentation: 三柄窄剑从两侧与身前汇成一锋，最亮点集中在收束时。

taixuan_guiyuan_cast.label: 归元：气息回流
taixuan_guiyuan_cast.presentation: 三柄玉白气剑与微风向自身归拢，淡光完成一次恢复读点。

taixuan_qinghui_status.label: 清辉：返照微光
taixuan_qinghui_status.presentation: 共同护体的绕剑之外，仅叠加一缕玉白弧光与低亮护壳。

taixuan_xinghe_status.label: 星河：双弧微光
taixuan_xinghe_status.presentation: 共同护体的绕剑之外，青白双弧与极淡护壳提供更强返照读点。

taixuan_taiqing_status.label: 太清：六米剑域
taixuan_taiqing_status.presentation: 六柄低亮气剑沿六米随身边界环行，周期攻击之间保持稀疏。

tianqing_nifeng_hit.label: 逆锋横扫
tianqing_nifeng_hit.presentation: 宽阔金色刃弧瞬切，窄金边余光收束，保留横扫的清晰方向。

tianqing_tianbeng_hit.label: 天崩
tianqing_tianbeng_hit.presentation: 两道同拍金色尖锋形成楔形破裂，中心短促震纹突出重劈。

tianqing_tianfeng_hit.label: 破阵
tianqing_tianfeng_hit.presentation: 锐窄金色穿刺芒集中于命中处，细小冲击圈迅速退去。

tianqing_wanjun_hit.label: 万钧
tianqing_wanjun_hit.presentation: 紧实金色破碎核心配局部厚震环，与整招一次的落剑同奏。

tianqing_lietian_hit.label: 裂天
tianqing_lietian_hit.presentation: 纵向金裂芒与小范围环纹强调切开目标的一击。

tianqing_tianjian_hit.label: 天剑坠世
tianqing_tianjian_hit.presentation: 温白金色压缩核心骤亮，重环在目标附近展开并留下清楚余光。

tianqing_bafang_hit.label: 八方灭阵
tianqing_bafang_hit.presentation: 双向短金芒同拍破裂，紧凑薄环点明每个受击目标。

tianqing_tiandi_hit.label: 天地剑劫
tianqing_tiandi_hit.presentation: 交错金裂芒与压缩震环统一短峰，每个真实阶段命中只亮一次。

tianqing_nixi_cast.label: 逆息回生
tianqing_nixi_cast.presentation: 金色环纹向内收息，柔亮金芒向上回升，体现回生而非重击。

xueyan_luexue_hit.label: 掠血·撕雾
xueyan_luexue_hit.presentation: A narrow bright blood blade cuts first; a restrained red puff follows.

xueyan_chuanshen_hit.label: 血影穿身·贯斩
xueyan_chuanshen_hit.presentation: A stretched piercing blood blade and a small torn mist at each real victim.

xueyan_liancheng_hit.label: 血影连城·单段
xueyan_liancheng_hit.presentation: One sharp blade peak per real pursuit attack; no four-stage playback.

xueyan_wusheng_hit.label: 血魇无生·单段
xueyan_wusheng_hit.presentation: One pale crimson blade through deep red mist per real attack; no six-stage playback.

xueyan_nixue_cast.label: 逆血狂澜·放卷
xueyan_nixue_cast.presentation: Eight short blood blades spread once toward the six-metre boundary and fold inward.

xueyan_xuehai_cast.label: 血海噬灵·开域
xueyan_xuehai_cast.presentation: A low circle of blood blades opens once; no per-victim domain replay.

xueyan_xuehai_hit.label: 血海噬灵·噬灵斩
xueyan_xuehai_hit.presentation: A small local blood cut for each actual BloodPulse hit.

xueyan_xuehai_status.label: 血海噬灵·赤环血雾
xueyan_xuehai_status.presentation: An open luminous crimson ring and twelve low red wisps mark the six-metre owner-following boundary.

xueyan_ranxue_cast.label: 燃血入狂·内聚
xueyan_ranxue_cast.presentation: Four short blood blades and wisps pull inward, then extinguish.

xueyan_huichao_cast.label: 回潮·回卷
xueyan_huichao_cast.presentation: Six crimson wisps and luminous blood threads converge into the chest, hold briefly and fade for both costs.

xueyan_damage_mode_cast.label: 血剑凝锋·切换
xueyan_damage_mode_cast.presentation: One brief bright blood-blade accent; the red identity survives either damage mode.

tianqing_tianfeng_cast.label: 天锋破阵：巨剑锋楔
tianqing_tianfeng_cast.presentation: 金色巨剑随角色沿冲阵方向前推，两侧低亮气流分开，停步后迅速退亮。

xueyanEchoVfx.semantics: three native equipped overlays; actual casts grouped into three pairs
